meta.title: Fantasy Concept Constellations
meta.visualContract: Every graph node is a normalized being/race/entity or class/vocation archetype. Characters and sources are evidence, never nodes.

domains.label: Beings & Peoples
domains.description: Peoples, ancestries, spirits, monsters, divinities, undead, constructs, and other kinds of being.

domains.label: Classes & Vocations
domains.description: Martial, magical, religious, social, specialist, craft, and progression roles.

nodes.label: Mortal and Natural Peoples
nodes.definition: Peoples presented as ordinary inhabitants of the setting's natural world, even when their biology differs from humans.
nodes.distinctions: Classify by ontology first; morphology, culture, and game creature type are separate axes.
nodes.functions: Organizes source-specific peoples and creatures by the kind of being they are.
nodes.representativeTerms: Player ancestries; nations; ethnicized fantasy peoples
nodes.caution: Preserve each source's ontology, culture, history, and terminology when making comparisons.

No fan wiki, Wikipedia, plot-summary site, or unsourced listicle is used as canonical evidence.
